name: dumbbell lying one arm rear lateral raise v. 2
description: Lying on your side on a bench, you raise a dumbbell out to the side. It isolates the rear shoulder.
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench holding a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Start with your arm hanging in front of you, slight bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out and up until it is about shoulder height.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
